info.name: VNeCA Unified v2 — Customer Signing / session workbench
info.description: Manual requests only. Local/Server environments are separate. Inspect QUICKSTART-VI.md first. Case/run/key registry never holds document/identity/continuation/bearer bytes. Private frozen requests and action handles use Postman Local Vault. Internal flow IDs are not customer fields. FAILED is never signing PASS. Real Provider actions may incur charges; only the operator chooses Send and performs actual consent. Do not run this collection.
